events.name: doc.command_panicked
events.summary: A command panicked; its transaction was rolled back

events.name: doc.patched
events.summary: The live document changed; apply `ops` to the document at `prev_rev`

events.name: doc.reset
events.summary: The document changed in a way ops cannot express; resync from a snapshot

events.name: job.progress
events.summary: A job was queued, started, progressed, was asked to cancel or finished (the whole job)

events.name: media.analysis_failed
events.summary: A background analysis stage failed on a media asset (it stays usable; previews may be missing)

events.name: media.indexed
events.summary: A media asset's frame index is ready (frame-exact seeking and decoding can use it)

events.name: project.autosave_failed
events.summary: An autosave attempt failed; it is retried automatically

events.name: project.closed
events.summary: The open project was closed; the engine now holds an untitled document

events.name: project.dirty
events.summary: The project gained or lost unsaved changes (last saved revision differs from the committed one)

events.name: project.opened
events.summary: The open project changed (opened, saved under a new path, recovery decided); payload: its status

events.name: project.recovery_available
events.summary: Unsaved work from a previous session can be restored or discarded

events.name: project.saved
events.summary: The project document was written to disk (autosave or explicit save)

events.name: tx.closed
events.summary: A transaction ended and released its soft locks

events.name: tx.locked
events.summary: A gesture or proposal soft-locked more items

events.name: tx.opened
events.summary: A transaction was opened (no items locked yet)
